Underwhelming and overpriced
Jul 2026 • Family
We came for the Angus beef and burger because we felt like a break from the otherwise magnificent local cuisine for 1 night. We were prepared to pay a bit extra for this but felt a bit fooled by the whole experience. It was impossible to communicate with the staff due to lack of English - which I thought would be essential given the selling point is the international kitchen. The were sold out of burger bread so no burger - fair enough. We were told they didn’t have the possibility of a rare steak, so the person who wanted the rare steak in the first place ironically ended up with a medium not even medium rare- all got lost in translation I believe. The meal was ordinary and not worth the price at all. This is mainly a bar and I would not recommend coming here for food as it is overpriced and not worth it.

A Culinary Adventure at Gemination Bar
Jul 2025 • Family
At Gemination Lounge Bar, crafted beverages are not just drinks; they’re an experience. The mixologists here take mixology to new heights, experimenting with flavors that dance on your palate. I had the chance to try their signature cocktail, the Tropical Fusion, which blends rum with exotic fruits and herbs. It was a delightful explosion of flavor! The atmosphere is warm yet vibrant, making it an ideal spot for both casual hangouts and special occasions. Each drink comes with a story, adding a personal touch to the experience. Gemination Lounge Bar truly elevates cocktail enjoyment to an art form!
